Definition: a Temanite or descendant of Teman
BiblicalUsage: Temanite or Temani = see Teman "southward"; 1) an inhabitant of Teman located east of Idumea; 2) a descendant of Teman, the grandson of Esau and a duke of Edom
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
